name: Philadelphia
living: the giant neon Liberty Bell swings gently side to side and pulses on a home run
the bell's neon outline buzzes with an occasional soft flicker
City Hall's clock face glows warm and the tower catches a slow glint
the twin glass spires' blue edge lights shimmer slowly up and down
stars twinkle in the deep blue sky while thin violet clouds drift by (sky layer drift)
a red aircraft warning light blinks atop the tallest tower
the HOME RUN DERBY board's bulb border chases around its frame
row-house and office windows flicker on and off
light-tower lamp banks glow and softly breathe, moths drifting through their cones
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
